info.title: API.SH: Reverb
info.description: The Reverb API from API.SH: public Reverb data as clean JSON. Every endpoint is a GET with query parameters and your key in the x-api-key header. Calls that run cost the credits shown (x-credits): successes, and lookups that found nothing (404). Refused calls and errors on our side are free. Docs: https://api.sh/docs · Every platform: https://api.sh/openapi.json

get.description:
Search gear for sale on Reverb with every filter the site's search takes: keywords, make, model, category, product type, condition (new, used, b-stock or a grade), finish, decade, year and price ranges, item location (region, state, city), ships-to country, free or expedited shipping, local pickup, handmade, preferred sellers, offers, sale, payment plans and gift cards, sorted by relevance, date or price. Each listing: id, title, make, model, finish, year, condition, price and buyer price (in the chosen currency), offers, inventory, state, dates, categories, location, shop, shipping rates, photos, stats, SKU, UPC, product id, description, link and `raw`. Pass `next_page` back as `page`; null on the last page (the site serves 50 pages).

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/reverb-search

parameters.name: q
parameters.description: Keywords (or a filter such as make, category or product_type).

parameters.name: product_type
parameters.description: Root category slug, e.g. electric-guitars, effects-and-pedals.

parameters.name: condition
parameters.description: new, used, b-stock or a grade (mint, excellent, very-good, good, fair, poor, non-functioning, brand-new); comma separated.

parameters.name: ships_to
parameters.description: Only listings that ship to this country (2 letters); shipping rates are shown for it.

parameters.name: include_sold
parameters.description: Also include ended and sold listings.

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

apiKey.name: x-api-key
apiKey.description: Create keys at https://app.api.sh/keys. Authorization: Bearer <key> also works.

raw.name: raw
raw.description: 0 leaves out the bulky `raw` source blocks (often 10-30x smaller).

fields.name: fields
fields.description: Comma-separated fields to return, e.g. `posts.id,posts.title`. Call metadata is always included.

fresh.name: fresh
fresh.description: 1 skips the 24-hour cache and fetches live.

output.name: output
output.description: csv or ndjson returns the response's records (its main list, or the object as one row) as CSV or NDJSON instead of JSON.

records.name: records
records.description: With output=csv|ndjson: the top-level list to turn into rows (e.g. `reviews`), or `.` for the whole object as one row.

status_url.description: On a 503 for a paused endpoint: the status page, which lists open incidents.

E400.description: A parameter is missing or invalid. Not charged (unless the call ran and the source rejected the value; credits_used says).

E401.description: Missing, invalid, revoked or expired API key. Not charged. See https://api.sh/docs/errors#401

E402.description: Not enough credits, a spend limit you set was reached (`spend_limit`), or the key's monthly credit cap was reached (`key_cap`). Not charged.

E404.description: Not found, or not public. A lookup that ran costs the endpoint's price (credits_used says); an unknown route is free.

E502.description: The source site failed this time; retry. Not charged.

E503.description: Endpoint paused or temporarily unavailable; may include retry-after, and status_url (https://api.sh/status) for a paused endpoint. Not charged.
